words.definition: The process of breaking down text into individual words or tokens.

sentence.sentence: The algorithm used tokenization to split the text into individual words.
sentence.translation: एल्गोरिथ्म ने पाठ को व्यक्तिगत शब्दों में विभाजित करने के लिए टोकनीकरण का उपयोग किया

words.definition: The process of reducing a word to its base form.

sentence.sentence: The algorithm used stemming to reduce words to their base form.

words.definition: The process of reducing a word to its base or root form.
words.definationTranslation: एक शब्द को उसके आधार या मूल रूप में कम करने की प्रक्रिया

sentence.sentence: Lemmatization is used to normalize words to their base form.

sentence.sentence: The algorithm used lemmatization to reduce words to their base form.

sentence.sentence: Named entity recognition is used to identify names, locations, and organizations.
sentence.translation: नामित इकाई पहचान नाम, स्थानों और संगठनों की पहचान करने के लिए उपयोग किया जाता है

sentence.sentence: The algorithm used named entity recognition to identify entities in the text.

words.definition: The process of identifying the part of speech of each word in text.

sentence.sentence: The algorithm used part-of-speech tagging to identify the parts of speech in the text.

sentence.sentence: Topic modeling is used to identify the underlying topics in a large corpus of text.

sentence.sentence: The algorithm used topic modeling to identify the topics in the text.

words.definition: The process of predicting the next word in a sequence of text.

sentence.sentence: The algorithm used language modeling to predict the next word in the text.

sentence.sentence: The algorithm used machine learning to train the machine.

sentence.sentence: The algorithm used pragmatics to analyze the context of the text.
